label: Doctor's tip · Iodine
head: Where do Vegans
get iodine?
name: Dr. Michael Klaper
end_cta: Find Dr. Michael Klaper on Vegans Explore

captions.text: Since Vegans, we don't eat fish, where do we get our iodine?
But if you wanna be natural,
you don't wanna get into the supplement game at all,
then you should find a way to get these sea vegetables into your diet.
There's the three that are the safest
and most delicious are wakame, arame, and dulse.
Throw a gob of it into your soup or into your salad a few times a week.
You'll get your iodine needs met.
That's really the best, most natural place to get your iodine.
